runner: real SubagentRunner via ctx.subagents (DeepSeek Harness session default model)

workload.baseline: one task implements src/alpha.js + src/beta.js and their tests
workload.swarm: two independent tasks, one module each, two workers, cross review, serial merge

notes: One sample per mode; manual orchestration in a live DSH session, not a statistically powered benchmark.
Total wall clock is 27% slower for the swarm on this tiny two-module workload; per-task wall clock is 37% lower.
Token cost is 52% higher in total and 24% lower per task; both are within the 3x budget ceiling.
The requirement target (swarm wall <= 70% of single) is NOT met at this workload size; use single mode for small tasks.
No model-price table was available, so USD cost is not reported.
